about_short_description.short_description: EQUATE Petrochemical Company is a global producer of petrochemicals & the world’s second-largest producer of Ethylene Glycol (EG).

product.name: Ethylene Glycol (EG)
product.description: Ethylene Glycol is used primarily as a raw material in polyester fiber production, automotive antifreeze, and various industrial applications.

product.name: Ethylene
product.description: Ethylene is a fundamental petrochemical used as a building block for producing plastics and other chemicals.

product.name: Polyethylene (PE)
product.description: Polyethylene is a versatile thermoplastic polymer used in a wide range of plastic products and packaging.

product.name: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET)
product.description: Polyethylene Terephthalate is a polymer used mainly for producing plastic bottles and packaging materials.

product.name: Styrene Monomer (SM)
product.description: Styrene Monomer is a chemical used as a precursor in producing polystyrene plastics and resins.

product.name: Paraxylene (PX)
product.description: Paraxylene is an aromatic hydrocarbon used primarily in producing polyester fibers and plastics.
